title: Crown Verity — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Crown Verity.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Commercial Outdoor." Specialty tier. Crown Verity is a Canadian manufacturer of commercial-grade mobile outdoor cooking equipment — large event grills, mobile kitchens, and catering equipment. Made in Brantford, Ontario.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Commercial outdoor events, catering, large-scale outdoor cooking.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Crown Verity:

• Commercial-grade mobile outdoor cooking

• Canadian-made in Brantford, Ontario

• Catering and event specialists

• Built for heavy commercial use

• Mobile kitchen solutions
